page: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-128 is an x86_64 server instance provisioned with 128 dedicated virtual CPUs across 64 physical cores using Intel Xeon processors clocked at 2.6 GHz. The architecture incorporates 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 54 MB L3 cache, alongside hardware instruction support for AVX-512, VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA extensions. Memory capacity is configured at 864 GB of RAM, equating to an allocation of 6.75 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include local disk storage or hardware accelerators, requiring external network-attached block storage for persistent data and operating systems.

Benchmark evaluations highlight substantial multi-threaded compute and memory throughput. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 84,295.77 and a Geekbench multi-core result of 17,383, placing it in the upper quartile of multi-core processing capability. Memory performance aligns with these results, measuring 329.21 GB/sec in large-block sequential uncached reads and 141.27 GB/sec in uncached writes. Single-core compute metrics are average, reflected by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,579 and a single-thread stress-ng metric of 1,845.38. For data operations, Redis SET operations reached 109.06 million operations per second, supported by 31,209.31 in PassMark database operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the resource profile trades single-threaded execution speed for dense parallelism and substantial memory headroom. The lack of bundled local NVMe storage requires factoring external storage attachment overhead into deployments. While CPU-based LLM prompt processing delivers solid throughput on models up to 7B parameters, text generation efficiency on large 70B parameter models is low due to the absence of dedicated GPU accelerators.

The n2-highmem-128 is designed for enterprise memory-intensive workloads that require large pools of shared memory alongside wide multi-threading. Typical deployment targets include large-scale in-memory caching clusters, relational database management systems, big data processing frameworks, software compilation pipelines, and memory-heavy analytics pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-128 is a memory-optimized compute instance powered by 128 dedicated vCPUs (64 physical cores) on 2.6 GHz Intel Xeon processors with 864 GB of system RAM. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture with AVX-512 instruction support, it delivers 6.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance includes no onboard local storage and no GPU accelerators. Benchmarks confirm upper-tier multi-threaded processing, evidenced by a multi-core Geekbench score of 17,383, a PassMark CPU score of 84,295.77, and uncached read memory bandwidth exceeding 329 GB/sec. Single-threaded metrics remain within the median range. Hardware throughput supports high-volume operations, sustaining over 109 million Redis SET operations per second. Given its large memory capacity, high core density, and dependence on network storage, the n2-highmem-128 is suited for large in-memory databases, distributed caching, enterprise analytics, and extensive software build environments.
